source_evidence: BDCs have more leeway than other closed-end funds, mutual funds, and ETFs to invest using debt and other leverage.
answer: Leverage means using debt or other methods to increase a fund’s investment exposure. BDCs have more leeway than other closed-end funds, mutual funds, and ETFs to use leverage. Since BDCs also have unique risks, the source suggests asking how much debt a BDC has taken on when learning about it.
